elaine (People Ops): Quick thread  Sam handed in notice this morning. Last day 2026-05-05. Need to coordinate device return, badge, final pay, COBRA window, and an exit interview.

ravi (IT): Thanks. Which devices? Will need shipping or drop-off plan to schedule wipe.

noah (Hiring Manager): Sam has a MacBook (asset 4901) and a company iPhone (asset 4902). He said he'd prefer to drop at SF office if possible.

sam (Engineering): I can drop both items at the mailroom on 5/4. I'll include the YubiKey.

elaine (People Ops): Great. Mailroom hours M-F 9-4; badge will be disabled 5/05 09:00 PT. We'll prepare a return confirmation email and a prepaid label in case plans change.

tess (Finance): Final paycheck will be on 5/15 payroll. PTO payout per policy. Benefits active through 5/31; COBRA packet emailed within 14 days. Email is fine?

sam (Engineering): Email preferred. Also, can you confirm RSU vesting details?

elaine (People Ops): I'll send equity and benefits summary today and loop Legal for any vesting specifics.

ravi (IT): IT checklist: log assets on receipt, secure wipe, remove from MDM, revoke SSO & VPN morning after wipe, rotate any service account keys Sam had access to. Will post confirmation when done.

offboard-bot: Offboarding workflow started for sam (ticket OFF-4507).

elaine (People Ops): Exit interview: optional 30min on 5/07 or 5/08 afternoon. Sam, which works?

sam (Engineering): 5/07 after 2pm PT works.

elaine (People Ops): Action items assigned in OFF-4507: People Ops (elaine)  benefits/equity note + schedule exit interview; IT (ravi)  device wipe & deprovision; Finance (tess)  final payroll + PTO calc; Hiring (noah)  knowledge transfer confirmation. I'll update ticket as items close. :white_check_mark:
